source.author: Mike Kasberg
source.units: mm assumed; corroborated by source sheet dimensions, STL contains no units

evidence: evidence/reference-sections.png; full component and socket measurements in reference-measurements.json
sourceDefects: 27 edge-adjacent components, nonwatertight. Used as design reference only; original CSG reconstruction, no automatic repair.

measuredSource.clipWidthBasis: Upstream flat_clip(4) / flat_clip_hole(4), with 0.25 mm each-side hole expansion; corroborates measured 4.50 mm socket, not a measured 4.50 mm male tongue.

designMapping.carrier: Original CSG shelf frame with 40 low breakaway runners, four per part; same carrier strategy as inspected reference, not raw mesh reuse.
designMapping.staticInterface: The 4.50 mm measured socket span becomes a deliberate new straight-tongue baseline, NOT the source clip width. New sockets are (4.50+c) by (sheet+c); c=0.10–0.30 mm total. No source snap clip is claimed or replicated; glue required.
designMapping.sheet: 2.2–3.0 mm is a stiffer redesign, not measured source thickness.
designMapping.runners: 0.4–0.6 mm tall, 0.8–1.2 mm wide; deliberately stronger than the reference low tapered runners.
designMapping.mechanism: Independent Jansen seven-moving-link construction replaces the cat assembly completely. 13 fixed ratio lengths plus adjustable scale/crank; two rigid triangle frames.
designMapping.hardware: Seven external M3 joints. Separate 0.20–0.50 mm diametral bore fit, 3.5–5.0 mm layer gaps. Hardware envelope bounded to 6.5 mm diameter / 3 mm beyond faces.
designMapping.art: Image or supported exact STL cutter engraves protected chassis patch with ≥1.5 mm backing, cannot enter joints.

kinematicSource.use: Factual linkage ratios and topology; original implementation, no diagram or source code bundled.
kinematicSource.variation: One raised hand-turned leg on a fixed stand, not a walking robot. Crank limited to 13–15 unscaled mm after clearance checks; 16 mm was rejected.

numericReproducibility: Local link coordinates, capsule lengths and angles quantized at 1e-7 mm / degree to prevent Node/Chromium libm differences from changing coplanar triangulation; final modeling simplify tolerance 0.001 mm. Reported closure residual includes this tiny quantization.

localCandidates.reasonRejected: Switch cavities and stem, not suitable sheet kit reference
8 mm interlocking link; not a sheet carrier or assembly interface
